integrity: The claimed unpointed homotopy type follows from group-coset surface pieces and their vertex-incidence graph. Finite computations only corroborate the all-parameter argument.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian groups, exactly three colors, two sum levels with a nonzero nongenerating difference; no nonabelian or equivariant homotopy assertion. Independent audit not yet performed.
title: Abelian two-layer complexes: a subgroup-index splitting into closed surfaces and circles
